items.title: Why Jaspr?
items.description: When to choose Jaspr over Flutter for web development
items.content: Why Jaspr + Arcane Jaspr? Jaspr and Flutter web use different rendering models. Choose between them based on the browser behavior your project needs. The Core Difference Flutter web can render an app through a canvas-based surface. In that mode, browser tools do not receive the same element tree as a normal HTML page. Jaspr renders semantic HTML. A button is a , text can be a , and a link is an . That distinction affects indexing, browser tools, accessibility, and page behavior. --- SEO and Disc
